definitions.explanation: The exact moment of 12 o'clock at night, marking the start of a new day.

examples.japanese: {午前零時|ごぜんれいじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎた→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧。
⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{午前零時|ごぜんれいじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。

{午前零時|ごぜんれいじ}⟦ちょうど→ちょうど：02916_choudo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わり→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧、⟦{花火|はなび}→花火：00087_hanabi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一斉|いっせい}→一斉：01726_issei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{打|う}ち{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: The year changed right at midnight, and fireworks were launched all at once.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{午前|ごぜん}→午前：00548_gozen⟧ (morning, AM) and ⟦{零時|れいじ}→零時：17204_reiji⟧ (zero o'clock). This is the precise, formal way to express midnight in Japanese. It is commonly used in schedules, announcements, and official contexts.

In casual speech, ⟦{夜中|よなか}→夜中：01008_yonaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{十二時|じゅうにじ}→十二時：10981_juuniji⟧ (twelve o'clock at night) or simply ⟦{真夜中|まよなか}→真夜中：05425_mayonaka⟧ (the middle of the night) are more natural.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {午前零時|ごぜんれいじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧: to pass midnight
- {午前零時|ごぜんれいじ}⟦ちょうど→ちょうど：02916_choudo⟧: exactly at midnight
- {午前零時|ごぜんれいじ}⟦{発|はつ}→〜発：04026_hatsu⟧: departing at midnight

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{真夜中|まよなか}→真夜中：05425_mayonaka⟧: the dead of night — refers to the general time period around midnight, not a specific clock time
- ⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧: late at night — broader term for the late-night hours
- ⟦{日付|ひづけ}→日付：03706_hizuke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: the date changes — another way to refer to the midnight moment
